title: unified-rollouts-manual-quarantine-and-probing-stages-for-canary-shadow-autorollback
author: Priya Patel
release_notes: Add manual quarantine and probing stages to unified rollouts; improves safety of canary and shadow deployments with metric quorum, staged probing, and explicit operator quarantine controls. Backwards compatible defaults preserved; feature gated behind rolloutConfig.experimental.probingQuarantine.
description: Context: We need stronger safety guards for canary and shadow rollouts after recent incidents where noisy metrics caused unstable autorollbacks. This PR adds two complementary controls: 1) a manual quarantine stage that allows operators to hold candidate traffic in a quarantined probe bucket before promoting to canary/ab groups, and 2) an automated probing stage that performs short-lived metric probes with quorum evaluation before applying weighted traffic. Summary of changes: implementation of a probing stage in the rollout engine, a manual quarantine flag and UI controls in the Console, metric-quorum evaluation logic used by the autorollback engine, new observability dashboards and alerts for probing failures, and e2e/unit tests. Design notes: probing runs N short probes (configurable; default N=3) across replica subsets and evaluates a composite metric quorum (latency + error-rate + quality-score). If quorum fails, the rollout either halts, quarantines, or triggers an immediate rollback depending on policy. Manual quarantine exposes an operator-facing hold step (UI + API) so safety teams can inspect telemetry before promotion. Feature gating: rolloutConfig.experimental.probingQuarantine: { enabled: false by default, probeCount: 3, quorumThreshold: 0.7, quarantineTimeout: 30m, autoQuarantineOnAlert: true }. Testing & rollout plan: unit + integration tests included, e2e in staging with staged shadow traffic for 24h, gradual enablement for internal teams followed by broad rollout. Linked Linear/Jira tickets included. Motivations and trade-offs noted in comments.
commits: 1) Add probing stage implementation and unit tests (engine/probing_stage.py) 2) Integrate probing with autorollback engine and metric-quorum evaluator (engine/autorollback.py) 3) Console: add manual quarantine UI and API wiring (console/components/rollout-config.tsx) 4) Observability: dashboards + alerts for probing/quarantine (observability/dashboards/rollout-probing.json) 5) Add e2e tests and test fixtures (e2e-tests/rollouts/probing_quarantine.test.ts) 6) Docs: rollout probing/quarantine guide (docs/rollouts/probing_quarantine.md)
